gen-tourney-fs-epilogue: Athletic and loud, Tourney stretches out its uniform strokes. Epilogue is the softer voice, with curvy, wiry letters and tall bodies that relax everything the heading tightens up.
gen-tourney-fs-merriweather-sans: Tourney stamps out wide-tracked words in strokes that never thicken or thin, chunky little lowercase and all. And Merriweather Sans answers with sturdy, tall letters whose open e keeps each line readable.
gen-dafont-nordic-fs-epilogue: Friendly, curvy and a bit loose, the body text feels modern against Nordic's pressed-in, ancient shapes. Epilogue keeps its wiry monoline letters open and easy, so a long page flows without the heading's cramped severity.
gen-dafont-impact-label-archivo: Commanding letters stand alone in Impact Label, each one set apart like a bead on a rod. And Archivo follows with outward-opening curves and a tall x-height, so longer stretches of text feel editorial and welcoming.
gen-fs-new-title-gf-glegoo: Glegoo reads refined and open, with big counters and curved letters that never close their mouths. New Title adds bold, modern punch.
gen-dafont-stencilia-satoshi: Structural, striking, a little severe. Stencilia sets tight, spiky structure against Satoshi's constant stroke and soaring x-height, and that gap between the two is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-gf-autour-one-switzer: Switzer brings Swiss tidiness, with tubular, wire-like letters and c tips that stay politely apart from each other. Autour One supplies the expressive, bold shapes above.
gen-eater-general-sans: Dark and a little menacing, Eater has wide gaps and short ascenders. General Sans follows with a smooth, steady stroke and a tall x-height, so nudge its size up if you want it to hold the line.
gen-gf-underdog-fs-rowan: Underdog cuts every curve at one depth, with a horseshoe-wide c that feels expressive and commanding. But Rowan adds friendly, literary thick-thin variation, and made large its generous curves would soften that heading's authority.
gen-gf-wallpoet-fs-paquito: Thin lines of paper show through Wallpoet's letters. Paquito brings a confident, approachable body with almost no step from lowercase to caps, which makes the pair's strongest quality its mix of boldness and ease.
